name: rajchowk-mvp
description: राज चौक — a minimal editorial publishing platform on AWS Amplify Gen 2
nameRationale: NOT 'rajchowk'. `ampx sandbox` derives its CloudFormation stack name from this field plus the local username, so `name: "rajchowk"` would resolve to the pre-existing amplify-rajchowk-<user>-sandbox stack that still hosts the v2 schema, and a sandbox deploy would overwrite 25 live tables with this one-model schema. The user-visible product name is NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME (राज चौक); this field is only a build identifier. See README, 'Deployment isolation'.

scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:amplify
scripts.verify: npm run ci:outputs:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run ci:outputs && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e

scriptsRationale.sandbox: --identifier mvp is load-bearing, not cosmetic. A bare `ampx sandbox` targets the stack keyed on <package name>-<username>-sandbox; the identifier gives this MVP its own stack so it can never collide with another sandbox in the same account.
scriptsRationale.ci:outputs: amplify_outputs.json is gitignored (it holds the User Pool ID, AppSync endpoint and API key) but is a STATIC import in src/lib/amplify/config.ts. Without a placeholder, webpack cannot resolve it and `next build`, lint, typecheck and tests all fail on a fresh clone before compiling anything. This writes a secret-free stub so every quality gate runs with no AWS account at all.
scriptsRationale.ci:outputs:check: Wired into `verify` so a schema change that was not synced into the CI fixture is caught locally rather than as a stale CI build. Run `ci:outputs:sync` after editing amplify/data/resource.ts or amplify/auth/resource.ts and commit the result.

overridesRationale.sharp: Next declares optional sharp ^0.34.3, and every 0.34.x inherits four libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). 0.35.x is a semver-minor bump with a stable API. Amplify Hosting supplies its own sharp at runtime, so this protects local dev and any self-hosted build.
overridesRationale.postcss: Next pins postcss 8.4.31 internally, which is affected by three sourceMappingURL/stringify advisories. Build-time only and processing our own CSS, but 8.5.x clears all three.
